firm.definition:
n. the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments
s. marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable
s. not soft or yielding to pressure
s. strong and sure
firm.translation:
n. 公司, 商号
a. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的
vt. 使牢固, 使坚定
vi. 变稳固, 变坚实
adv. 稳固地

firm bid.translation: [经] 确定的出发价, 递确(实)盘

firm brokerage.translation: [法] 股票公司, 经纪商行

firm name.translation: [法] 行业名称, 商店名称

firm offer.translation: [经] 确定的报(发)价确盘, 稳价, 限期内有效发价

firm order.translation: [经] 确认订单, 定期定货

firm time.translation: [化] 变硬时间; 硬化时间

firm trading market.translation: [经] 稳定的贸易市场, 实际的市场

firm up.translation: （使）更结实; （使）更坚硬; 把…安排得更稳妥; 使稳定

firmament.definition: n the apparent surface of the imaginary sphere on which celestial bodies appear to be projected

firmamental.definition: a. relating to the firmament or upper regions
firmamental.translation: a. 天空的, 苍天的

firman.definition:
n. In Turkey and some other Oriental countries, a decree or
   mandate issued by the sovereign; a royal order or grant; -- generally
   given for special objects, as to a traveler to insure him protection
   and assistance.
firman.translation: n. (昔时土耳其皇帝等的)敕令

firmans.translation: n. 昔时土耳其皇帝等的勒令( firman的名词复数 )

firme.translation: abbr. Fondo de Inversiones Rentables Mexicanas (Spanish=Mexican Rental Investments Fund) （西班牙语）墨西哥租用投资基金会

firmed.definition:
v become taut or tauter
v make taut or tauter
firmed.translation: vt.& vi. 使坚固（firm的过去式与过去分词形式）

firmer.definition:
s marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable
s not soft or yielding to pressure
s strong and sure
s not subject to revision or change
s (of especially a person's physical features) not shaking or trembling
s not liable to fluctuate or especially to fall
s securely established
s possessing the tone and resiliency of healthy tissue
s securely fixed in place
s unwavering in devotion to friend or vow or cause
firmer.translation: a. 圆凿或凿子的；坚固的

firmer chisel.translation: 扁錾; 平錾; 凿; 铲

firmest.definition:
s. marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable
s. not soft or yielding to pressure
s. strong and sure
firmest.translation: firm（坚固的, 坚牢的）的最高级形式

firmeza.translation: [地名] [玻利维亚、古巴] 菲尔梅萨

firmin.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 弗明来源于中世纪拉丁语教名，含义是“坚定的”(firm,resolute)

firming.definition:
v become taut or tauter
v make taut or tauter
firming.translation: vt.& vi. 使坚固（firm的现在分词形式）

firmly.definition:
r with resolute determination
r in a secure manner; in a manner free from danger
r with firmness
firmly.translation: adv. 坚固, 坚定, 断然

firmness.definition:
n. the muscle tone of healthy tissue
n. the property of being unyielding to the touch
firmness.translation: n. 坚固, 坚牢, 坚定

firms.definition:
n the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments
v become taut or tauter
v make taut or tauter
firms.translation: n. 公司, 厂商（firm的复数）

firmware.definition: n. (computer science) coded instructions that are stored permanently in read-only memory

firmware classification.translation: [计] 固件分类法, 硬件分类法

firmware monitor.translation: [计] 固件监督程序, 固件监督器

firmware specification.translation: [计] 固件说明, 固件描述
